children: How much does mobile app development cost in Singapore?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-9bedb84 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: MVP builds start around SGD 30,000 and take 8 to 12 weeks. Feature-rich platforms with AI integration or custom backend work run from SGD 80,000 to over SGD 200,000, with a 3 to 6 month timeline, depending on platform count and integration complexity.
How long does it take to build a mobile app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-31d37170 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: An MVP typically takes 8 to 12 weeks to build. Larger, feature-rich products take 3 to 6 months, depending on the number of platforms, integrations, and how much custom backend work the product needs.
Should I build a native or cross-platform mobile app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-15a22925 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Native development suits products that need deep platform-specific features, top-tier performance, or heavy App Store optimization. Cross-platform frameworks like Flutter or React Native suit products prioritizing speed to market and a shared codebase across iOS and Android.
Do you develop mobile apps for startups and established businesses in Singapore?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-53502494 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Inceptives Digital builds mobile apps for startups validating a first product and for established Singapore businesses scaling an existing platform, with the same senior engineering team involved from discovery through launch on both.
Can you modernize or improve an existing mobile application?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-1e6225e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. A UI refresh, a performance fix, a cloud migration, or a full rebuild all start with a technical assessment of the current app before any code changes, so the recommendation matches what the app actually needs.
Which industries does Inceptives Digital build mobile apps for?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-3ee19adf e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Inceptives Digital has shipped mobile apps across more than 20 industries, including FinTech, healthcare, logistics, eCommerce, education, real estate, manufacturing, travel, and fitness. A related industry outside this list is still worth a conversation.
Do you provide UI/UX design as part of mobile app development?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-55d690f6 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. UI/UX design runs inside the discovery and validation stage of the project, with real users testing interactive prototypes before development starts, so usability problems surface while they are still cheap to fix.
Can you integrate third-party services and enterprise systems into my mobile app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-2f148ec2 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Backend and API development covers integrations with payment platforms such as PayNow and SGQR, identity and authentication services like SingPass and MyInfo, as well as CRM, ERP, and other third-party APIs. Every integration is designed to support reliable performance and future product growth.
Will you publish my app to the Apple App Store and Google Play?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-c581467 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. The deployment stage handles App Store and Google Play submission, including compliance checks, metadata setup, and store listing requirements, so the app clears review without a delay-causing resubmission.
Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-1e4c53e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Post-launch support covers performance monitoring, security updates, and feature enhancements after the initial thirty-day window included with the project, so the app keeps working as OS versions and user expectations change.
How do you ensure security and PDPA compliance in mobile apps?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ad2ef83 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Every build follows PDPA data handling requirements, OWASP Top 10 protections against common vulnerabilities, and encryption for data at rest and in transit, with security reviews running through the QA stage before any release reaches production.
Why choose Inceptives Digital as your mobile app development company in Singapore?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-14e8aaa e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Senior engineers stay on the project from discovery through launch, architecture follows PDPA-compliant standards, and the same team has shipped mobile apps across more than 20 industries.
Do you sign NDAs before discussing a mobile app idea?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-9e40c11 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Inceptives Digital signs a mutual NDA before any product discussion that involves proprietary details, protecting the idea, the data, and the business model discussed on the call.
